description: Defines the CertNetFetcher interface for fetching certificate-related URLs (AIA, CRL, OCSP) with reference counting and thread safety, including nested Request class for handling fetch results.

classes.name: CertNetFetcher
classes.description: Interface for fetching certificate URLs, supporting asynchronous requests and shutdown.

classes.name: CertNetFetcher::Request
classes.description: Represents an ongoing fetch request, allowing waiting for result or aborting.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Cancels all outstanding network requests; must be called from network thread.

methods.name: FetchCaIssuers
methods.description: Starts fetch for CA issuer URLs, returns a Request object.

methods.name: FetchCrl
methods.description: Starts fetch for CRL URLs, returns a Request object.

methods.name: FetchOcsp
methods.description: Starts fetch for OCSP URLs, returns a Request object.
